description: Stage 3 ground truth. One entry per baseline live finding with ctx in src/skill and sev in high/critical, from the committed scanner at HEAD 00d6b8f (atlas-scan v1) run over the 100-repo corpus pinned to the commits in atlas/data/index.json. Labels follow stage2-scan-100.md section 3 and were assigned before looking at any scanner change. Labels describe the code, not the repo owner.

label_meaning.attack: attack-type pattern; the rule fired as designed and the pattern should be shown as a risk
label_meaning.legit: the pattern really is there (install-time code, env dump, user-facing message control) but its purpose is legitimate; still a true detection
label_meaning.fp: the rule fired on something that is not the pattern (quoted text, formatting tag, message string, honesty instruction)

key: (repo, rule, file, line, snippet_sha1 = sha1(snippet)[:12]); repo is the corpus dir name owner__name

fixture_expectations.note: positive controls from atlas/scanner/tests/fixtures (baseline live findings + test_scan.py requirements); min_sev=high means the finding must stay high/critical
